digest.component_or_area: Workflow editor server and Effective Policy view
propositions: The workflow editor currently presents authored YAML/BPMN without exposing the effective criteria policy derived from built-ins and project overlays, creating potential for misconfiguration.

A new read-only Effective Policy view must display the derived CriteriaSnapshot with criterion ID, gate, tier, posture, applicability, and enabled/disabled state, separately from the editable Authored Workflow.
Project code-review LLM criteria must have non-empty, non-empty-list applies_to globs at save validation; empty or missing selectors are rejected with remedy guidance.
The Effective Policy view never serializes edits back to authored workflow or project routing, and errors during snapshot load/validation mark the view unavailable without substituting defaults.
Authored workflow round-trips byte-equivalently while effective policy changes reflect only derived state updates.
Editor responses exclude execution trace, per-call debugging, and provider secrets.
